observation.command:
cd /workspace
curl -sS http://localhost:8080/processes 2>/dev/null | /workspace/.venv/bin/python -c "
import sys, json
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
print(type(d).__name__, 'len', len(d))
for item in d:
    if isinstance(item, dict):
        name = item.get('name')
        st = (item.get('status') or {}).get('state')
        pid = item.get('pid')
        ns = item.get('namespace')
        print(f'{ns or \"root\":8s} {str(name):30s} {str(st):20s} pid={pid}')
"
